map.绝缘电阻 120MΩ（≥100 ✓）、体积电阻率 1.2×10¹²Ω·m（≥1: Insulation resistance 120 MΩ (≥100 ✓), volume resistivity 1.2×10¹² Ω·m (≥1 ✓), aging retention 85% (≥80 ✓): all three pass → qualified. If retention drops to 75% it fails, insufficient durability.
